Node: v22.22.3   Resource: https://atf-demo.aauth.dev
Agent provider: https://dickhardt.github.io (harness/setup.mjs)

Every byte below is machine-produced. harness/setup.mjs mints the tokens;
client.mjs signs the requests and prints what it sent and what came back.
Regenerate with: node harness/capture.mjs

The appraisal behind these tokens is the committed evaluator output from
the summit repo with its validity window moved onto the current clock,
which invalidates the evaluator’s signature over it. Nothing here verifies
that signature: the grade reaches the resource as the agent provider’s
assertion, held on the provider’s authority. See harness/setup.mjs.

0. What the resource says it requires

$ curl -s https://atf-demo.aauth.dev/.well-known/aauth-resource.json
{"issuer":"https://atf-demo.aauth.dev","access_mode":"agent-token","name":"ATF Demo Resource","description":"The relying party of the CSA Verifiable Agent Summit chain. It accepts an AAuth agent token carrying a signed ATF grade, verifies the agent provider and reads the grade the provider vouches for, then decides for itself. `GET /agent/echo` reports what it verified; `GET /api/summarize` applies the same gate and then challenges for a person token, because a qualifying level is eligibility for consideration and not permission.","documentation_uri":"https://github.com/aauth-dev/atf-demo","revocation_endpoint":"https://atf-demo.aauth.dev/revoke","https://agentictrustframework.ai/policy":{"profiles":["csa-atf:0.9.1"],"minimum_level":"senior","evaluators":["https://demo.verifiedagents.ai"]}}

The ATF requirement lives under the namespace ATF owns. There is no
jwks_uri: this resource issues no tokens and signs no calls, so it
publishes no keys and holds no secret.

There is no status_channel either. The channel is the evaluator’s, and
the evaluator names it inside the signed appraisal. Withdrawal here is
AAuth revocation, advertised as revocation_endpoint and shown below.

================================================================
Revocation — AAuth §Token Revocation
================================================================
A fresh Senior token, revoked by its issuer, then presented again.

This is the path that replaced the ATF status channel. Josh’s profile has
the evaluator publish withdrawals to a channel a relying party polls;
under this flow the agent provider watches that channel and pushes here
instead. No evaluator in the request path, and no fail-open/fail-closed
question, because there is nothing to fail to reach.

$ node harness/revoke.mjs --url https://atf-demo.aauth.dev
iss  https://dickhardt.github.io
jti  fa2f761f-9f85-4a26-8fbc-a777f4d1b469
exp  1788775945

401 Unauthorized
aauth-requirement:requirement=agent-token

{
  "type": "about:blank",
  "title": "Unauthorized",
  "status": 401,
  "error": "agent_token_revoked",

}

=== result ===
before:           200
after:            401

401 and not 403: the signature verified and the claim was coherent, but
the credential is no longer good — the same shape of condition as expiry,
and the same remedy. No Signature-Error, because the registry in
draft-hardt-httpbis-signature-key has no code for a revoked token and
expired_jwt, the nearest, would be false.

The revoking call carries exp so the resource can size its store: an
entry only has to outlive the token it names. AAuth’s revocation request
has no exp field, which is spec issue #146. Without one this resource
falls back to 24 hours.

================================================================
Summary
================================================================
  valid      200  verification report
  tampered   401  Signature-Error: error=invalid_jwt
  no-atf     401  AAuth-Requirement: requirement=agent-token
  expired    401  Signature-Error: error=expired_jwt
  revoked    401  agent_token_revoked, after POST /revoke

Every error body is application/problem+json, and where a Signature-Error
header is present the body’s `error` repeats it.

Not shown here: atf_subject_mismatch, the one refusal no fresh token
repairs. It needs a claim whose appraisal_subject and workload_id
disagree, so it is covered in test/gate.test.ts rather than by a client
that only holds well-formed tokens.

Two more 403s used to live beside it — atf_status_unavailable and
atf_appraisal_superseded. Both read a Worker environment variable rather
than anything at runtime, so neither could ever fire in production, and
the metadata promised a fail-closed status channel the code never
fetched. Both are gone, and revocation does the work.
